configurations.name: zali-server
runtimeArgs: k="$(grep -E '^KLIPY_APP_KEY=' .env 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-)"; [ -n "$k" ] && export KLIPY_APP_KEY="$k"; exec cargo run --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml -p zali_server

configurations.name: zali-server-sfu
runtimeArgs: k="$(grep -E '^KLIPY_APP_KEY=' .env 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-)"; [ -n "$k" ] && export KLIPY_APP_KEY="$k"; SFU_UDP_PORT=3479 JWT_SECRET=local-dev-sfu-secret-not-for-production-0001 ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:8090,http://localhost:8090,http://127.0.0.1:8092,http://localhost:8092 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_DEBUG=true exec cargo run --release --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml -p zali_server

configurations.name: zali-server-sfu-rig
runtimeArgs: mkdir -p /tmp/zali-sfu-rig && BIND_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3001 ZALI_DATA_DIR=/tmp/zali-sfu-rig SFU_UDP_PORT=3480 SFU_PUBLIC_IP=127.0.0.1 JWT_SECRET=local-dev-sfu-rig-secret-not-for-production-01 ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:8090,http://localhost:8090 ALLOW_GUEST_MODE=false AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=false exec server/target/release/zali_server

runtimeArgs: mkdir -p /tmp/zali-sfu-rig && BIND_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3001 ZALI_DATA_DIR=/tmp/zali-sfu-rig SFU_UDP_PORT=3480 SFU_PUBLIC_IP=127.0.0.1 JWT_SECRET=local-dev-sfu-rig-secret-not-for-production-01 ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:8090,http://localhost:8090 ALLOW_GUEST_MODE=false AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=false SFU_TEST_LOSS_IN=3 SFU_TEST_DELAY_TO_PUB_MS=30 exec server/target/release/zali_server

runtimeArgs: mkdir -p /tmp/zali-sfu-rig && BIND_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3001 ZALI_DATA_DIR=/tmp/zali-sfu-rig SFU_UDP_PORT=3480 SFU_PUBLIC_IP=127.0.0.1 JWT_SECRET=local-dev-sfu-rig-secret-not-for-production-01 ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:8090,http://localhost:8090 ALLOW_GUEST_MODE=false AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=false SFU_TEST_STALL=70/520/256 SFU_TEST_DELAY_TO_PUB_MS=3 RUST_LOG=zali_server::sfu=debug,zali_server=info exec server/target/release/zali_server
